title: Step of an Embedded Multi-Tape Machine
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $O$ be an oracle language over its symbol alphabet, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$. One step of the oracle machine obtained from $M$, with oracle $O$, starting from the embedding of $c$, equals the embedding of the configuration obtained by one step of $M$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-tape Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
An oracle language $O$ over the symbol alphabet
replaced:
Let $M_0$ be a plain multi-tape machine with $k$ work tapes, let $O$ be any
oracle language, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M_0$.  One step, relative
to $O$, of the oracle machine obtained by embedding $M_0$, taken from the
embedding of $c$ into the $(k+1)$-tape oracle model, equals the embedding of
the configuration obtained by one step of $M_0$ from $c$.
